help:
agentic-flow-kit v{{version}}

Usage:
  flow-kit install --agent <host> [--agent <host>...] [--lang zh-CN|en] [--stack dotnet|node|typescript|rust|go|java|empty] [--tier lean|standard|enterprise] [--hardened] [--target <dir>] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--no-model-config] [--dry-run] [--force] [--no-git-config] [--track-hosts]
  flow-kit add-host <host> [--target <dir>] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--no-model-config] [--dry-run] [--force]
  flow-kit upgrade [--target <dir>] [--model [host:]role=<id>] [--model-mode recommend|detect|inherit] [--probe-models] [--dry-run] [--force]
  flow-kit doctor [--target <dir>] [--deep] [--fix]
  flow-kit list-hosts

Hosts: trae, codebuddy, claude, opencode, qwen, pi, cline, commandcode, qoder, zcode

Model roles: code (implementation) / judgment (reasoning) / review (independent verification; prefer different from code)

Example:
  node cli-tools/agentic-flow-kit/bin/flow-kit.mjs install --agent claude --lang en --model claude:code=haiku --model claude:review=opus --target .
